title: GoldLoop
script:
getgenv().GoldLoop = false

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local HRP = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

task.spawn(function()
    while getgenv().GoldLoop do

        for _, v in ipairs(workspace.GoldBars:GetDescendants()) do
            if not getgenv().GoldLoop then break end

            if v:IsA("TouchTransmitter") then
                HRP.CFrame = v.Parent.CFrame
                task.wait(0.5) -- Adjust the speed here.
            end
        end
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)
